$comment: Example Switchboard snippets. Copy the entries you want into ~/.claude-switchboard/snippets.json (Switchboard: Open Snippets File). Variables: ${selection}, ${file}, ${clipboard}, ${input:Question}.

snippets.name: Explain selection
snippets.description: Understand unfamiliar code before changing it.
snippets.text:
Explain what this code in ${file} does, step by step. Point out anything surprising, any hidden assumptions, and how it is used elsewhere in the project. Don't change any files.

```
${selection}
```

snippets.name: Review file
snippets.description: Focused review of the open file; asks what to focus on.
snippets.text: Review ${file} with a focus on ${input:Focus (e.g. error handling, performance)?}. List concrete problems with line numbers, most important first, and suggest a fix for each. Don't edit the file yet.

snippets.name: Write tests for selection
snippets.description: Unit tests that follow the project's existing test style.
snippets.text:
Write unit tests for the following code from ${file}. Follow the style and framework of the existing tests in this project, cover edge cases, and run the tests at the end.

```
${selection}
```

snippets.name: Fix from error
snippets.description: Paste a stack trace or CI log from the clipboard.
snippets.text:
This error occurs:

```
${clipboard}
```

Find the root cause, fix it with the smallest sensible change, and verify the fix. Explain the cause in two sentences.

snippets.name: Commit message
snippets.description: Conventional commit message for the staged changes.
snippets.text: Look at the staged changes (git diff --cached) and write a conventional commit message: a subject under 72 characters and a short body explaining why. Don't commit.

snippets.name: Plan before coding
snippets.description: A plan without edits, for larger changes.
snippets.text:
I want to: ${input:What do you want to change?}

Don't edit any files yet. Read the relevant code, then give me a short plan: the files to change, the approach, the risks, and how we will test it.
